comment: Teacher accurately links context, audience, theme, evidence, metaphor/parallelism, and purpose in nonfiction analysis.
Lesson revisits guided annotations, builds from context/audience to important words, subjects, themes, evidence, strategies, group sharing, and independent completion.
Teacher repeatedly elicits student answers, checks partial reasoning, validates/revoices themes, and monitors groups before moving to independent work.
Teacher uses sustained why/how/infer prompts about context, audience, uncertainty, themes, strategy, and authorial purpose.
Strong analytical modelling overall, with minor opportunities to make the complete claim-evidence-strategy reasoning frame more visible and reduce cognitive load.
